args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
===========================

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, hat, water bottle)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera (with waterproof case if possible)
- Travel documents (passport, ID, hotel confirmations, flight tickets)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Flip flops/sandals
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Rain jacket (Hawaii weather can be unpredictable)
- Snorkeling gear (if not renting)
- Reusable water bottle
- Power bank for electronics
- First aid kit
- Insect repellent
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case

Don't forget:
- Chargers for all devices
- Travel adapter if needed
- Medications
- Credit cards and some cash
- Travel insurance information
